title: 临床长上下文推理中的抑制性注意力：表征与缓解电子病历处理中的“迷失在中间”效应
summary: 该研究首次系统表征了电子病历（EHR）处理中的临床“迷失在中间”（CLitM）问题，发现模型对长上下文中间信息的检索可靠性显著下降。提出了查询条件临床抑制（QCCS）轻量级选择门，在指令跟随准确性上优于BM25、稠密检索等基线，表明查询对齐的上下文选择比黄金句子检索召回更能预测准确性。
summary_en: This study systematically characterizes the clinical lost-in-the-middle (CLitM) effect in EHR processing, showing degraded retrieval of central information. It introduces Query-Conditioned Clinical Suppression (QCCS), a lightweight selection gate that outperforms retrieval baselines in instruction-following accuracy, suggesting query-aligned context selection predicts accuracy better than gold-sentence recall.
